title: What if the space station just fell? 🛰️
subject: station
description:
Where do you think the pieces would land? 👇

What happens if nobody boosts the International Space Station? NASA says it would fall within 1 to 2 years, and big pieces would survive the trip down. It has happened before: Skylab rained over Western Australia in 1979.

Sources: NASA, "FAQs: The International Space Station Transition Plan" (2024); NASA, "ISS Deorbit Analysis Summary" (June 2024); Space.com, "40 Years Ago, NASA's Skylab Space Station Fell to Earth" (2019); Guinness World Records, "First fine for littering from space".
tags: what if the space station fell

scenes.text: Stop pushing the ISS, and it falls from the sky.
Thin air drags on it even 257 miles up. NASA gives it 1 to 2 years without boosts.
Most of it burns. The heavy truss sections don't, and NASA warns of very large debris.
In 1979, Skylab rained across Western Australia. The town of Esperance fined NASA $400 for littering.
So SpaceX is building a tug to drop the ISS into an empty ocean in 2030.
